lines.name: Geelong Line
lines.description: V/Line's busiest corridor, from Southern Cross to Geelong and on to Warrnambool in the southwest.

lines.name: Ballarat Line
lines.description: Serves Melbourne's west through Melton to Ballarat, with extensions to Ararat and Maryborough.

lines.name: Bendigo Line
lines.description: Runs northwest through Sunbury to Bendigo, with extensions to Echuca and Swan Hill.

lines.name: Seymour Line
lines.description: The northeast corridor through Seymour, extended by Shepparton and Albury services.

lines.name: Gippsland Line
lines.description: Heads east through the Latrobe Valley to Traralgon, with services continuing to Bairnsdale.
